native_title: L2-acyclicity and cost for a rank-100 amalgam
display_title: L²-acyclicity and cost for a rank-100 amalgam
printed_abstract_original_TeX_whole: We give a direct calculation of all $L^2$-Betti numbers of the rank-100 amalgam in OpenAI's fixed-price construction. An elementary regular-tree argument makes its cellular boundary injective, proves its displayed presentation complex aspherical, and gives $\beta_n^{(2)}(\Gamma)=0$ for every $n\geq0$, independently of either cost bound. Combining this calculation with OpenAI's positive Bernoulli cost estimate gives an explicit free ergodic probability-measure-preserving orbit relation with cost at least $1+(100\cdot2^{61})^{-1}$ and vanishing $L^2$-Betti numbers. The group infimum cost remains one. The construction and positive cost estimate are due to OpenAI; the cost--Betti comparison and action invariance are due to Gaboriau. This is an attributed consequence and verification note, with a separate direct invariant proof.
printed_abstract_readable_math_whole: We give a direct calculation of all L²-Betti numbers of the rank-100 amalgam in OpenAI’s fixed-price construction. An elementary regular-tree argument makes its cellular boundary injective, proves its displayed presentation complex aspherical, and gives βₙ⁽²⁾(Γ) = 0 for every n ≥ 0, independently of either cost bound. Combining this calculation with OpenAI’s positive Bernoulli cost estimate gives an explicit free ergodic probability-measure-preserving orbit relation with cost at least 1 + (100·2⁶¹)⁻¹ and vanishing L²-Betti numbers. The group infimum cost remains one. The construction and positive cost estimate are due to OpenAI; the cost–Betti comparison and action invariance are due to Gaboriau. This is an attributed consequence and verification note, with a separate direct invariant proof.
native_description_HTML_original_whole:
An expanded consequence and verification note for OpenAI's rank-100 fixed-price construction. A self-contained regular-tree and cellular-boundary calculation proves that its displayed 101-generator/100-relator presentation complex is a finite two-dimensional classifying space and every L2-Betti number vanishes, independently of either cost bound. Gaboriau's action invariance and OpenAI's positive Bernoulli cost estimate then give an explicit free ergodic p.m.p. orbit relation with Cost at least 1 + 1/(100*2^61) and vanishing L2-Betti numbers. The group infimum cost is one.

The group and positive cost estimate are due to OpenAI; cost--Betti comparison and action invariance are due to Gaboriau. The general fixed-price implication was already explicit in Popa--Shlyakhtenko--Vaes, and the short conditional limit argument was already in the author's public preliminary triage. Added content is the direct all-degree invariant proof and reproducible input-validation record. No independent fixed-price discovery or firstness is claimed. The pinned upstream source warns that its source argument was intermediate. Its pivotal proof is explicitly identified and independently audited in the supplement.

AI tools were used extensively in research, drafting and adversarial verification. At publication this preprint has not undergone conventional human peer review or refereeing. Automated audits are neither human refereeing nor machine formalization. The package contains the paper source, exact arithmetic and Fox-identity checks, scoped proof audits, source hashes, priority record and clean reproduction instructions.

group: A=F(a,b1,...,b99), w=ab1ab2...ab99a, J=<b1,...,b99,w>, Gamma=A*_J(J x <t>);101 generators/100 relators [t,bi] and [t,w].
direct_claim: The displayed presentation complex is a finite two-dimensional K(Gamma,1); every L2-Betti number of Gamma vanishes in all degrees n>=0, independently of either cost bound.
action_claim: The invariant conull free part X of the product-Lebesgue Bernoulli shift is free, ergodic and p.m.p.; every essentially free p.m.p. action has all Betti numbers zero by Gaboriau action invariance, without requiring ergodicity.
positive_cost_claim: The Bernoulli orbit relation has cost at least1+1/(100*2^61)>1 using the substantial attributed OpenAI positive cost input, not from the direct invariant calculation.
group_infimum_claim: Cost_*(Gamma)=1 is an infimum over essentially free p.m.p. actions; no action attaining1 is asserted. The Y_M upper bounds1+99/M for M>100 and classical comparison give the infimum independently of the Bernoulli positive lower bound.
comparison: Cost(R)-1 >= beta1^(2)(R)-beta0^(2)(R); zeroth correction matters for finite classes. Infinite free orbits have beta0=0.
